record.amendmentRecord:
Self-amended 2026-06-04 — axiomregent demotion. axiomregent is no longer an
independently released product (see 037, amended): it is an internal upstream
component of OPC, built from OPC's release commit and bundled as a Tauri
sidecar. The paired train therefore collapses to a SINGLE product. This
amendment removes the `axiomregent-v*` tag grammar, the cross-product boundary
invariant (opc.minor == axiomregent.minor — there is no second product to
pair with), and the guard's axiomregent product arm; the version-consistency
guard becomes OPC-only. release-axiomregent.yml is retired. The OPC mechanics
(product-prefixed `opc-v*` tag, draft-first publish, fast-fail version-guard
job, SBOM assertion) are unchanged.
record.summary: Establish OPC's release cadence, a product-prefixed tag grammar (opc-v*), and a pre-publish version-consistency guard that refuses any release whose tag disagrees with its committed version sources or its SBOM. OPC builds a draft first so every publish is guard-gated AND human-gated. Closes the class of bug where a release envelope (tag) carried one version while the artifacts carried a stale committed version (OPC drafts v0.3.5/6/7 shipped 0.3.4 assets). Amended 2026-06-04: OPC is the sole release lever — axiomregent is an internal upstream component bundled by OPC (037, amended), so the paired cadence and the axiomregent-v* tag grammar are retired and the guard is OPC-only.
record.title: Paired release cadence + version-consistency guard (amends 037, 086, 117)
